Aranyosapati Jewish Cemetery in Kopocsapati

Jewish Cemetery · Aranyosapáti, Hungary

Not demolished. One of two Jewish cemeteries in today's Aranyosapáti (formed in 1950 by merging the villages of Révaranyos and Kopócsapáti), this one served Kopócsapáti's community. It appears on an 1870 cadastral map, though its oldest surviving tombstone dates only to 1937, its newest to 1943. Kopócsapáti's Jewish population numbered 76 in 1841, peaked at 95 in 1880, and had fallen to 58 by 1941 - yet according to Yad Vashem records, 79 of the village's Jews were murdered in the Holocaust, suggesting the community included residents beyond those counted in the 1941 census.
